qwen.ref_text: On the battlefield, four players with monster-like strength appeared. Each of the players had already destroyed their colonies. These players were so equally strong, they created a four-way deadlock.

lines: Phase six. Error detection and correction. This is how data survives a noisy wire.
A message travels down a wire as bits. Then noise strikes.
A message travels as bits.
One bit flips. A zero was sent, and a one arrives.
Noise on the wire flips a bit.

Fix: add a check bit.

Three bit words sit on a cube. One flip is one step.
One flip is one step.
Only zero zero zero and one one one are valid words.
Only 000 and 111 are valid words.
